status: headless theme state and per-document system appearance implemented; DOM theme delivery remains
contract: Authored inputs remain separate from effective values. Omission inherits; explicit auto uses the local system source and explicit normal overrides compact.
An omitted appearance follows its parent's resolved appearance, supporting a live opener binding without forcing the destination document's preference.
Parent and system sources can be replaced. Immutable snapshots and complete patch validation keep TanStack the state owner.
The document preference resource shares one native media observation per document, releases the final listener, and reacquires from current native state.
No preference storage, root mutation, DOM context transport or named-theme lookup is added.

findings: Current base.ts uses a document-global appearance observer and does not invoke its saved cleanup. Current state.ts and Theme Switcher still own root/storage behavior until their atomic replacement.
Palette generation is root-only. Scope CSS must preserve conditional palette tiers and redeclare scope-sensitive semantic aliases.
A composed context request is a candidate for nearest-provider discovery across slots/shadow roots. No transport implementation is certified here.
@lit/context is not installed or selected; no dependency is silently added.
A full token mapping and the remaining font-weight/channel-color findings must be resolved before full registerTheme delivery.
research.nextAtomicSlice: Theme scope CSS, acme-theme, AcmeElement integration and the controlled Theme Switcher must change together.

limits: Native lang/dir behavior remains with the DOM and consuming components; this model does not invent locale canonicalization or direction rules.
Named theme existence belongs to the registry; undefined effective name means house tokens without reserving a public name.
Browser adoption checks exercise resource binding, not complete DOM theme-provider discovery.
Nested live scopes, late providers, slot reassignment, native/scoped registries, portal themes and full custom token registration remain M05/integration gates.
